answer: Bind each identity to a nonce-chained work history: every completed job publishes a signed record containing the previous hash, forming a basalt column of labor. Forking an identity into parallel sybils means splitting the chain, breaking the nonce sequence and exposing the fake instantly. Reputation and task access derive from chain depth, so one usable sybil costs months of honest labor plus an echo of every past record. Like karst, the history is porous to newcomers yet any tunnel around it collapses the identity.
